description: The chart illustrates the distribution of tasks across various language families, with the vertical axis listing the categories in descending order of task count and labeled with language family names, and the horizontal axis representing the number of tasks, ranging from 0 to 80 in increments of 10. The bars are colored differently for each language family, with IE-Slavic having the longest bar at approximately 78 tasks, colored light blue, and Turkic having the shortest bar at around 7 tasks, colored purple. The other language families, in order of task count, are IE-Romance with around 73 tasks (dark blue), IE-Germanic with about 44 tasks (green), Uralic with approximately 30 tasks (pink), IE-Baltic with around 24 tasks (red), IE-other with about 19 tasks (orange), IE-Indic with roughly 16 tasks (brown), and Semitic with approximately 11 tasks (gray). The bars are sorted in descending order by task count, with no additional visual emphasis or annotations.
